title: Wilfred Owen and the Realities of War

overview.body: This self-study resource explores how Wilfred Owen presents the realities of war through his poetry.

learning_purpose.body: The activities progress from contextual understanding to textual analysis and evaluation.

knowledge_summary.body: Wilfred Owen's poetry challenges idealised representations of war by foregrounding lived experience.

study_tips.body: Work through the activities in sequence and keep notes from each stage.

activities.title: Experience Shapes Representation
activities.learner_task: Study the explanatory material and worked example. Then write a short paragraph explaining how personal experience can shape literary representation. Finally, apply the model to Wilfred Owen by explaining why a poet with battlefield experience might focus on suffering, trauma, and loss rather than glory.
activities.expected_output: A coherent explanatory paragraph that clearly links experience, perspective, thematic focus, and representation. The response should use appropriate literary terminology and show a logical cause-and-effect chain.
activities.activity_preamble: Begin by building a conceptual model of how a writer's lived experience can influence literary representation before applying that idea to Wilfred Owen.

required_materials.purpose: Introduce the relationship between experience, perspective, and representation.
Model explanatory reasoning using an analogous non-war example.

materials.title: Experience and Representation
materials.body: Literary representation is influenced by perspective, and perspective is influenced by experience.

materials.title: Model Explanatory Paragraph
materials.body: A writer's experiences can influence how events are represented in literature.

criteria.statement: Have you explained a clear chain from experience to representation?
criteria.why_it_matters: The response should show causal reasoning.

features.repair: State how experience alters perspective and representation.

activities.intellectual_coherence_bridge: This opening activity establishes the core explanatory relationship that underpins the whole session: experience influences perspective, and perspective influences representation.
activities.reasoning_orientation: Focus on causal explanation rather than description.
activities.self_explanation_prompt: How might direct experience of conflict lead a poet to emphasise different aspects of war from someone relying on patriotic ideals alone?

evidence_decision.reason: The activity develops a conceptual model and does not require inspection of source evidence.

learning_outcomes.statement: Describe how Wilfred Owen's First World War experiences influence his presentation of the realities of war.
